title: The Veil of Highmoor
author: Coral Ishikawa
blurb: Sable Okafor, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
